notes: Scope from the claim's sentence: the subject is 'the raw June‑2020 telemetry for Chiller 6' (span [5090:5127]); the claim is one example inside an 'e.g.' list.
Read as existential: somewhere in June 2020, two consecutive 15-minute Condenser Water Flow samples go from about 0 to about 11,200 (ambiguity amb:620:reading).

link_assessment.reason: sensor_stats records month count/min/max/mean for the sensor (min 0.0, max 11206.94) but nothing about which samples are adjacent; not what P is about (0.3 §5.5, §7.1). It could support a separate range proposition; any bridge to P is inference (§7.4).

history covers 2020-06-01 only (96 observations; no zero values; largest consecutive step 11130.68 -> 411.95). One day cannot bear against an existential claim over the month, and it contains no 0 to support it.
